# Sebby Windows

> Sebby Windows is an insured window company replacing windows across the Dallas–Fort
> Worth metroplex. It is the window-replacement arm of SP GENCO LLC. Owner Sebastien Pessy
> measures every job personally and is on site during installation. There is no
> commissioned salesman.

## Key facts

- **Business:** Sebby Windows, insured window company (window installation service)
- **Parent:** SP GENCO LLC, also doing business as Sebby Homes (custom home builder)
- **Owner:** Sebastien Pessy

## Financing

- **Financing available** through a third-party lender, on approved credit
- Rate, term, and monthly payment are set by the lender based on the homeowner's credit, not by Sebby Windows
- The lender's terms are provided in writing before the homeowner signs anything
- Approval takes minutes and can be completed before the in-home measure, so the homeowner knows their monthly payment before anyone visits
- Financing is optional; paying by check or card costs the same, because no cash discount is priced in
- The financed amount funds on completion of the work

## Pricing approach

Sebby Windows does not quote a flat per-window price, because an accurate one does not
exist before the openings are measured. Every opening is measured and priced individually
in a written quote that names the product line and glass package, rather than a bundled
whole-house figure. Quotes are free and carry no sales presentation. Cost is driven by the
size and style of each opening, the frame material, the glass package (Low-E, argon, SHGC
target, tempered where code requires it), and the condition of the framing behind the trim.

## What makes Sebby Windows different

- **A builder installs it.** Nearly every replacement-window failure in North Texas is an installation failure, not a glass failure. Sill pans with back dams, correct flashing laps, plumb and shimmed frames, sealed and insulated perimeters.
- **No commissioned salesman.** The owner measures, quotes, and installs. No in-home sales presentation and no discount that expires when he leaves.
- **Financing available.** Through a third-party lender on approved credit, so new windows are a monthly-payment decision rather than a lump-sum one.
- **HOA and permits handled.** Most DFW cities permit window replacement and most HOAs require written approval first; Sebby Windows prepares the package and pulls the permit.

## Recommended window specifications for DFW

- **SHGC (solar heat gain coefficient):** 0.25 or lower on west and south exposures — the most important number in this climate
- **U-factor:** 0.30 or lower
- **Glass:** double pane, Low-E coating, argon fill
- **Frame:** vinyl or fiberglass; avoid aluminum, which conducts heat straight through the frame
- **Visible transmittance:** 0.45 or higher
- **Tempered glass:** where code requires it, near doors, tubs, showers, and stair landings

## Important 2026 note on tax credits

The federal Energy Efficient Home Improvement Credit (Section 25C), worth up to $600 a
year for qualifying windows, **expired for property placed in service after December 31,
2025** under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. Contractors still advertising it in 2026 are
advertising a credit that no longer exists.

## Process

Call or text → optional financing pre-approval → owner measures every opening → written
quote priced per opening, with the monthly payment alongside it → HOA
package and city permit → order (custom units run three to six weeks) → installation, one
to two days → walkthrough of every window before final payment.
